hello.text: Hiya! What are you doing today?

carry.text: Welcome back! Let’s carry on where we left off.

last.text: That’s all the photos. Nice one! Tap Finish when you’re ready.

talk.text: Now tell me what each photo shows. I’ve put some ideas for what to talk about.

questions.text: Now answer a few questions, in your own words.

done.text: That’s you done for today! Your evidence is saved in your portfolio. You can do another one if you like.

help:home.text: Tap what you’re doing today, and I’ll show you which photos to take, one at a time.

help:activity.text: This is what we’ll get evidence for. The number shows how many times it’s already in your portfolio. Tap Begin evidence when you’re ready.

help:camera.text: Take a photo of what it says under the picture, and I’ll tell you what’s next. Skip any you can’t get today.

help:talk.text: Say what each photo shows, using the ideas to talk about. Then tap Save.

help:portfolio.text: All your saved work is here. Tap one to see it, then tap Share to send it.

help:progress.text: The ring shows how much of your course has evidence. Tap a KSB to see what it means.

help:learn.text: Tap Teach me for short lessons, or EPA practice to test yourself.
